uninspected_available_images: Huang main Figures 1, 2 and 4 reacquired but not visually reassessed for new claims in this pass.

claim_assessment.locator: Original Figure 3E, bottom No microbe trace; caption/prose attribution from prior round88 handoff, current full-main reacquisition unsuccessful
claim_assessment.observation: Original graphic is byte-identical to prior. A square is visible within No microbe. Dry HC and Dry LC also carry squares. The panel does not label light versus dark.
claim_assessment.decision: Retain existing annotation ambiguity. No resolved control phase, detection limit, raw peak, or culture-specific phase fraction is inferred.

claim_assessment.locator: Results first mineral subsection; douchi2024-minimal.txt lines 463-480; Methods inoculation subsection lines 1455-1469
claim_assessment.observation: Results explicitly gives 3 micrograms chlorophyll per polycrystalline chip. Shared Methods gives 200 micrograms chlorophyll per mL and 100 microliters per chip.
claim_assessment.decision: 20 micrograms is arithmetic, not a corrected 15-day dose. No arm-specific lower dilution or correction was acquired.

claim_assessment.locator: Results subsequent single-crystal paragraph, text lines 506-517; Methods alternate crystal subsection
claim_assessment.observation: Results separately states 100 microliters corresponding to 20 micrograms chlorophyll on (011) or (010) single-crystal pieces for 30 days. Main text attributes oriented and scraped-surface null results to Supplementary Figure S1A-C.
claim_assessment.decision: The 20-microgram statement belongs to the separate 30-day arm. It does not reconcile the polycrystalline 3-versus-20 discrepancy. S1 graphics were not acquired or inspected.

claim_assessment.locator: Methods XRD analysis paragraph, text line 1470 onward; original Figure 1B axes; Figure 1C
claim_assessment.observation: Methods identifies cobalt source/Panalytical for chips, copper K-alpha/Bruker D8 for scraped powder, and says all patterns are presented for copper K-alpha. Figure 1B explicitly labels lambda-Co.
claim_assessment.decision: Instrument distinction is reported, but the blanket presentation statement conflicts with Figure 1B. No numerical peak conversion or phase quantification admitted.

claim_assessment.locator: Original Figure 1A-C and caption; Results mineral subsection; Methods strain/chip/XRD subsections
claim_assessment.observation: Three chip profiles per strain and sterile BG11 blank are shown for the 15-day comparison. Main text reports only gypsum and no difference from blank.
claim_assessment.decision: Retain qualified independent 15-day null under tested synthetic-chip conditions. No calibrated detection limit, absolute zero transformation, or universal refutation inferred.

claim_assessment.locator: Original Figure 2 and caption; Results following S1 discussion
claim_assessment.observation: Chlorophyll growth curves after transfer to fresh BG11 compare Day 0, 2 and 15 pretreatments.
claim_assessment.decision: Recovery of growth is contextual survival evidence, not a lattice-water uptake assay or recovery yield.

claim_assessment.locator: Current complete reply, original Figures 1-2; current PubMed relations; cached primary correction text in web-search-1/3
claim_assessment.observation: Reply describes selected gypsum-only starting regions, defends diffraction assignments, and gives corrected 5 x 8 x 0.5 mm coupon dimensions. PubMed continues to link the known correction and two comments.
claim_assessment.decision: Same Huang experimental lineage, not independent replication. The correction resolves coupon dimensions, not the Figure 3E square. Current direct correction HTML failed; cached primary correction excerpt is separately labeled.

claim_assessment.locator: Complete original 2-page author-host PDF; Figure 1 and Table 1 on PDF page 2
claim_assessment.observation: Critique contests initial mineral mixture, diffraction identification, chemical interpretation and attachment specificity. Table 1 compares reported and theoretical spacings.
claim_assessment.decision: Retain attributed counterinterpretation; corrected coupon objection is not reopened. Images/table do not supply raw original control diffractograms.

access_findings: Douchi complete public minimal HTML has malformed href http://Supplementary data in its Supplementary Data paragraph. This is an observed link in that representation, not proof that the complete publisher page lacks downloadable files.
HAL current record lists exactly one files_s entry, Douchi et al main text HAL.pdf; the direct file route returned anti-bot HTML. No supplementary file listed in that response.
Huang EuropePMC supplementaryFiles responds HTTP 200 with XML saying article is not open access; fullTextXML responds 500; BioC responds no result. These are not files containing assay data.
Official NLM public bucket exact prefix PMC7245118 gives KeyCount 0 and IsTruncated false. This is limited to this bucket/prefix, not proof of no supplementary publication.
PMC main/correction return reCAPTCHA HTML; the instance supplement route returns a preparing-download JavaScript interstitial. No challenge completion or access bypass attempted.
Public indexed Douchi PDF token returns session-timed-out 400 text. It is not accepted as a PDF.
Publisher SI routes return 403, eScholarship/CDLib routes return 403/robot verification; author lab page links DOI only. No genuine SI acquired.

decision.reason: Existing qualified owners retain the demonstrated discrepancies and missing-SI limits. This pass yields reproducible current access/provenance evidence, not corrected assay metadata or new accepted phase evidence.

handoff_priorities: Obtain genuine publisher/repository SI for each study, with parent DOI, original bytes and figures, before extending supplement-dependent claims.
Resolve Huang Figure 3E control square through attributable annotation correction/raw control traces tied to illumination arm, starting phase and analytical detection limit.
Resolve Douchi 15-day polycrystalline loading and figure-specific radiation/angle metadata; do not transfer 30-day single-crystal dose or scraped-powder source to the 15-day arm.
Curate only newly verified bounded claims with parent approval, history and independent native owner review; none proposed from this pass.
